desc: The ReachIR is a premium handheld observational thermal monocular series. All models come equipped with twelve micron infrared detector and a 1024x768 OLED display, for improved color rendering. The ReachIR thermal sensors also come equipped with the most sensitive temperature ratings in its class, coming in at sub-20 millikelvin across the entire product family. Other important options include a 1,000-meter integrated laser rangefinder (LRF), robust body and a removable, rechargeable 18650 battery.
